reading_note: The teaching describes four successive lamentations of the divine truths (garments/sons) sent forth from the First Man into the realm of self-love. The first three weepings mark moments in the descent and engagement: seeing falsity-from-evil arrayed at a distance, foreknowing what the encounter would bring, and yet pressing in by the necessity of the divine order. The fourth and final weeping is the consummation: at the last judgment, when the gathered Human-form (Last Andrias) is separated from those souls who confirmed themselves in evil. Those souls are bound to hell as they desired; the structural truths (firmaments/elements) grieve over them, and their grief alone has no end, because for those eternally lost no rest can come. The arc moves from descent-into-conflict, through endurance-by-necessity, to final separation and the eternal grief of truth over the willingly damned.
